subdivision_of_building: The proposal only affects the shopfront on the ground floor and the footpath and the 1st -2nd floor rear of the property for the ductwork.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal, by reason of the submitted noise impact assessment applying an incorrect noise technical standard and having not accurately determined whether the proposed mechanical plant's noise impact on neighbouring residential properties would comply with the noise technical standard outlined by British Standard BS8233 (2014) Guidance on sound insulation and noise reduction for buildings, contrary to Paragraph 198 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan Policy D14 and Local Plan Policy EQ5.

Reason : 2 - The proposal, by reason of the submitted odour impact assessment applying outdated and inaccurate nationally recognised air quality technical standards and having not correctly determined whether the proposed mechanical plant would have a neutral impact on the surrounding area's air quality and impact on neighbouring amenities, contrary to Paragraph 199 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan Policy SI1, Local Plan Policy EQ4 and Emerging Local Plan Policy EQ4.

Reason : 3 - The height and cowl design of the proposed commercial kitchen air extraction system's vent not being fit for purpose to ensure compliant dispersion of extracted air from the proposed commercial kitchen and protect neighbouring residents from exposure to odour and any air pollutants remaining in such emissions post filtration, and part of the duct and vent oversailing a neighbouring property outside of the site's boundary thereby reducing its accessibility and increasing its risk of being inadequately maintained, contrary to Paragraph 199 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan Policy SI1, Local Plan Policy EQ4 and Emerging Local Plan Policy EQ4.

Reason : 4 - The incongruous design, inefficient layout and excessive scale of the proposed commercial kitchen air extraction system's external rear duct and vent which would be harmful to the character and appearance of the terrace, the visual amenities of neighbouring residents and Chiswick High Road Conservation Area, and inadequate material details being submitted for the appearance of the three proposed air conditioning units' louvred enclosure to be assessed, contrary to London Plan Policies D4 and HC1 and Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and CC4.

Reason : 5 - The proposal makes inadequate provision for fire safety statement, as no being submitted as part of the planning application, increasing the risk that fire safety has not been properly considered as part of the planning process, contrary to London Plan Policy D12.
application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Installation of a replacement recessed ground floor Crittal glazed shopfront with a glazed single door, glazed serving hatch and bifolding windows, roof light to the existing single storey rear extension, ground floor rear Crittal window, rear kitchen extraction system duct and vent (with a silencer) and three enclosed air conditioning units to the building.
